Method of Attack: JavaScript fingerprinting using 'scheme flooding' vulnerability to track users across different browsers by probing installed application URL handlers
Attack Vector: Probing application URL handlers (e.g., zoommtg://) to detect installed applications and create unique tracking IDs
Indicators of Compromise: Application prompts triggered by URL handlers such as zoommtg://
Method of Attack: Vulnerability allowing cross-browser user tracking via application URL handler probing
Attack Vector: Exploitation of external protocol handler settings to trigger application prompts
